Permits & License Committee  January 22, 2026
Minutes  Page 1 of 6

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  January 22, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st Fl
Floor. On January 22, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Victoria Ojeda, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on January 8, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Julio Garcia on behalf of LA Clippers LLC to host an All-Star Alley Event at 3800 W. Century
  Blvd; Private Property, from Friday, February 13, 2026 through Sunday, February 15, 2026,
  from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for three (3) day
  event within private property. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and
  all applicable mitigation measures. Approved; IPD personnel will be deployed at this event
  for public safety. TCO's will be deployed for traffic congestion mitigation. Applicant to hire
  a min. of fourteen (14) Intuit Dome security personnel to assist IPD with any potential
  crowd control. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws: two (2) Code Enforcement staff
  to be deployed to address unpermited vending and noise mitigation; No additional
  conditions needed for Fire Apprroval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned
  correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426268)
 Permits & License Committee  January 22, 2026
Minutes  Page 2 of 6

Item #2:  Naoemi Sanchez on behalf of Northgate Gonzales Markets to host a Happy Valentine's
  Day Flower Sale Event at 10801 S. Prairie Ave; Private Property; on Saturday, February
  14, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one
  (1) day event within Northgate Market parking lot. Applicant is responsible for crowd control,
  event clean-up, and all applicable mitigation measures. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations. Approved; IPD will deploy one (1) sgt and six (6) police officers for public
  safety and five (5) TCO's for street closures. Meridian Barriers are required for street
  closures to ensure maximum pedestrian safety during the event. Mr. Emory Ward will be
  contacted to assist with staffing a minimum of four (4) city hall security officers at this event
  to assist IPD with any potential crowd control; Conditions: 2 Code Enforcement staff to be
  deployed for vending enforcement and noise mitigation; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426283)

Item #3:  Keoika Childress on behalf of City of Taste of Inglewood / David Rice to host a Love N
  Basketball All Star Block Party Event on Market Street between Regent and Locust; Public
  Property; on Saturday, February 14, 2026 from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day event on Market Street between Regent St and
  Hillcrest Blvd and adjacent streets. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the
  right-of-way. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all
  applicable IMC regulations.IPD- recommendations TBD; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426243)

Item #4:  Alvin Stanford on behalf of City of Think True LLC to host an All-Star Weekend Jordan
  Dome Event at 106 E Manchester Public / Private Property on Thursday, July 16, 2026,
  Friday, July 17, 2026, and Saturday, July 18, 2026; Hrs of operations subject to IPD, traffic
  contro plan subject to Public Works, security plan subject to pending documents; Applicant
  must pay in full – one week before the scheduled event;APPROVED CONDITIONALLY;
  Approval for a five (5) day event on private property and adjacent streets. Subject to Public
  Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant responsible for crowd control,
  event clean up, and all applicable mitigation measures. Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426364)

2026 - New Business License Request (s):
Item #6:  Suzanne Brown, on behalf of Coco Brown Care Service, to operate as a Nursing /
  Healthcare Facility Event at 2421 W 85th St. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT
  TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and
  tax fees; Applicant must have accurate employment records on all employees at all
  times;Not to exceed six (6) tenants/patients without a city approved Special Use
  Permit.Business owner and/or facility is subject to random inspection by any city, county,
  or state Police and/or Code Enforcement officers during hours of operation to ensure
  patient(s) good welfare, health and safety; Business owner/employer is responsible for
  maintaining accurate and updated employee records for all employee’s;Business
  owner/facility is strictly prohibited from hiring or employing any person registered under
  California Penal Code Section 290 PC or any person that may pose a public safety
  risk/threat to patients or other employees at the location; andAdhere to all State, Federal,
  County Laws and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future Business License application requests.
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426246)

Item #7:  Adrea Feinstein on behalf of Fleet Mobility Solutions (CA) LLC to operate as a Bus Charter
  / Limousines service at 9150 Aviation Blvd.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT
  TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and
  tax fees; All employees must have current valid driver’s License.All vehicles must have
  proof of current valid vehicle registration and insurance at all times.If required a Class P-
  Charter Party Permit must be obtained. Applicant/owner shall NOT employ or have any
  290 PC registrants employed or any persons that may pose a threat to the safety of patrons
  or the general public.Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  Business License application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00426292)

Item #9:  Hane Zorzour Faulk on behalf of RIO Reserve Inc. to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at
  10012 Hawthorne Blvd. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY This Business License has
  been APPROVED with the following condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses
  Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically;
  CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE
  OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations;
  Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25% of total retail floor area Sales or display of
  single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes
  ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little
  Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts
  Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers,
  Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly Prohibited;Tobacco or smoke shop
  retailers are required to immediately remove any Kratom related products, including
  natural Kratom and any products containing 7-OH, from store shelves and cease all
  sales;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is
  strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
